key_insight: The paper establishes almost sure boundedness and convergence of SGD to the set of critical points in deep linear networks under mild conditions.
engineering_relevance: The results strengthen theoretical foundations for stochastic training in a tractable non-convex model, covering both deterministic and adaptive step sizes.
method: Analyze SGD for deep linear networks with regularized squared loss.
Prove almost sure boundedness of the iterates.
Use asymptotic pseudotrajectories to establish convergence without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical guarantees, not empirical benchmarks or dataset-based evaluations.
watch_item: Convergence to the critical-point set does not guarantee global optimality, and the results concern linear rather than nonlinear networks.
paper_title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
